name: Slumbering Ancient Wyrm Lair
description: A terrifying red dragon of the First Age sleeps upon a mountain hoard of ancient gold, stirring periodically.
creativePrompt: What legendary hero died attempting to claim the dragon hoard? What tribute do villagers offer?
exampleNarrative: Sulfurous smoke vented from the caldera where the great wyrm slept, coiled around the crowns of fifty forgotten kings.

name: Arch-Lich Undead Necropolis
description: An immortal sorcerer-king raises an army of skeletal legions from an ancient crypt to reclaim their lost empire.
creativePrompt: Where is the phylactery hidden? What ancient curse prevents the dead from resting?
exampleNarrative: Ghostly green fire flared upon the black towers of the necropolis as legions of skeletal warriors marched forth.

name: Sunken Temple of the Sea-Gods
description: Submerged coral-encrusted ruins of a drowned civilization rise briefly above the waves during spring equinox.
creativePrompt: What aquatic monstrosities guard the drowned altars? What lost relics can be recovered during low tide?
exampleNarrative: At lowest ebb, dripping marble pillars and cyclopean temples arose from the surf, gleaming with pearls and weed.

name: Lost Star-Metal Blade of Kings
description: An enchanted meteorite sword embedded in a sacred stone, awaiting the rightful unifier of the realms.
creativePrompt: What prophecy foretells the coming of the hero who can draw the blade from the granite?
exampleNarrative: Embedded deep within the altar stone, the starmetal blade hummed softly, awaiting the hand of the true sovereign.

name: Unsealed Abyssal Demonic Breach
description: An ancient protective ward cracks open in the badlands, allowing fiendish horrors to spill into the mortal world.
creativePrompt: What sacrifice is required to reseal the hellish rift before the fiends consume the province?
exampleNarrative: Brimstone and red lightning tore through the fracture in the earth as horned horrors poured into the mortal twilight.

name: Cursed Barrow of the Witch-King
description: Fog-shrouded burial mounds where restless wights and shadow-wraiths guard accursed cursed treasure.
creativePrompt: What spectral cold chills the bones of anyone who steps over the barrow ditch after nightfall?
exampleNarrative: Pale will-o-wisps danced across the heather-covered mounds where ancient kings lay in restless, gold-clad slumber.

name: Slumbering Stone Colossus of the Pass
description: A thousand-foot carved stone sentinel slumbering against a mountain pass that awakens when the horn is sounded.
creativePrompt: Who holds the ancient ivory horn that can rouse the stone titan to defend the land?
exampleNarrative: Travelers mistook the great weathered face for natural crags until the stone eyes slowly opened to watch the valley.

name: Cosmic World-Gate to the Outer Heavens
description: Activate an ancient stellar portal ring allowing star-voyagers and demigods to cross into other worlds.
creativePrompt: What other created worlds lie on the far side of the gate? Who holds the keystone?
exampleNarrative: Rings of iridescent light spun within the gigantic portal, revealing distant constellations and strange alien moons.
